purpose.summary: This subprogram (ORCSCKTKNKCHK) is part of the ORCA JMA standard medical receipt (claims) software. It performs contraindication (kinki) drug combination checks and editing for outpatient/inpatient medical treatment records, including checking against interaction master tables (tbl_interact) and check master tables (tbl_chk). It supports initialization, individual drug check, and full-set drug check modes controlled by a function code parameter.

verdict.notes: The file is part of the well-known open-source Japanese medical receipt system ORCA (JMA). Comments are in Japanese encoded as EUC-JP or Shift-JIS but decoded as latin-1, causing mojibake in the displayed text. The program uses a proprietary MCP database abstraction layer rather than EXEC SQL. No COPY bodies are shown (only directives), so full data layout cannot be verified, but all structural indicators confirm genuine production COBOL.
